title: The Bell Over the Door
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值判断与人生信念）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值判断与人生信念）　|　核心词汇：thing　|　正文 317 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thing 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother ran a shop for thirty-one years, and at the end of it the only ① thing she wanted to keep was the bell over the door, which was worth nothing and which she took down herself on the day she closed. She said a shop is not a thing you own but a thing you do, and that most people get that the wrong way round.

In 1979 ② things got worse, as they do: a supermarket opened eleven miles away and half the village went to it on Saturdays. She did not lower her prices, and she did not open on Sundays, and she said the ③ thing was not to be cheaper but to be there on the Tuesday when nobody else was. That was the whole of her economics.

④ The thing is, she was not a kind woman, or not only. She knew everybody's business and she repeated it, and my mother says that is exactly why people came. ⑤ For one thing, she never forgot a name; for another, she never forgot what you had bought the week before, which is either kindness or a kind of arithmetic, and she never said which.

The ⑥ things people said about her after she died were all the same, that she had been there. She said once that doing the ⑦ right thing is not a decision but a habit, and that a habit is the only thing you can still keep after the shop has shut.

In 1991 a ⑧ thing happened that I have never written down: she gave a woman eleven pounds and told nobody, and the woman's son told me eleven years later. The ⑨ thing I inherited was the bell, which I hung in my own hall and which my daughter broke inside a week. The ⑩ things that last, I think, are not things at all, and she knew that, and she kept the bell anyway.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 东西；物品；物件
C. n. 情况；局面；事态（常用复数 things）
D. n. （人们说的）话；说法（the things people say）
E. n. 要紧的事；关键（the thing / the important thing）
F. 固定搭配：the thing is ... 问题是；情况是……
G. 固定搭配：for one thing ... 首先；一则……
H. 固定搭配：the right thing（to do）正确的做法；该做的事

items.q: the only thing she wanted to keep
things got worse, as they do
the thing was not to be cheaper but to be
The thing is, she was not a kind woman
For one thing, she never forgot a name
The things people said about her
doing the right thing is not a decision
a thing happened that I have never written
The thing I inherited was the bell
The things that last, I think

answers.why: thing 意为“东西、物件”，她唯一想留下的东西是门上那只铃铛，一文不值。
things 意为“情况、事态”，1979 年情况变糟了：十一英里外开了一家超市。
the thing 意为“要紧的事、关键”，她说要紧的不是更便宜，而是周二别人都不在时你在那里。
the thing is ... 意为“问题是、情况是……”，问题是，她并不算一个善良的人，或者说不只是。
for one thing ... 意为“首先、一则……”，一则她从不忘记别人的名字。
the things people said 意为“人们说的话、说法”，她死后人们说的话全都一样：她一直在那里。
the right thing 意为“正确的做法、该做的事”，她说做正确的事不是一次决定，而是一种习惯。
a thing 意为“事情、事件”，1991 年发生了一件事，我至今没有写下来。
the thing 意为“东西、物件”，我继承的东西是那只铃铛。
things 意为“（笼统的）事物、情况”，我想，能留存下来的东西根本不是东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 她唯一想留下的东西是门上那只铃铛，一文不值。（thing）
1979 年情况变糟了：十一英里外开了一家超市。（things）
她说，要紧的不是更便宜，而是周二别人都不在时你在那里。（the thing）
问题是，她并不算一个善良的人，或者说不只是。（the thing is）
一则她从不忘记别人的名字，二则她从不忘记你上周买了什么。（for one thing）
她说，做正确的事不是一次决定，而是一种习惯。（the right thing）
answers: The only thing she wanted to keep was the bell over the door, which was worth nothing.
In 1979 things got worse: a supermarket opened eleven miles away.
She said the thing was not to be cheaper but to be there on the Tuesday when nobody else was.
The thing is, she was not a kind woman, or not only.
For one thing, she never forgot a name; for another, she never forgot what you had bought the week before.
She said once that doing the right thing is not a decision but a habit.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 thing 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandmother ran a shop for thirty-one years, and the only thing she wanted to keep was the bell over the door.
She said a shop is not a thing you own but a thing you do, and in 1979 things got worse when a supermarket opened eleven miles away.
The thing was not to be cheaper but to be there on the Tuesday when nobody else was; that was the whole of her economics.
The thing is, she was not a kind woman, or not only: for one thing she never forgot a name, for another she never forgot what you had bought.
The things people said about her after she died were all the same, and she had said that doing the right thing is a habit, not a decision.
The thing I inherited was the bell, and the things that last, I think, are not things at all.
